title: #31 What Was Done In Your Name: The Constitution, The Corporation, and The Redemption
summary: Substack post claiming the 1871 Act incorporated the US, birth certificates pledged people as collateral, and 2025 UCC filings seized the corporation.

assertions.quote: Created by the District of Columbia Organic Act of 1871
Look up the ALL CAPS name on your birth certificate
Enslaved the people as collateral through birth certificates

verdicts.note: UCC filings by individuals cannot affect a sovereign government; the US government continues to operate.
OPPT promoters claimed UCC filings had 'foreclosed' governments and banks and promised $10 billion in gold each; nothing was delivered and they blamed aliens.

assertions.quote: the destruction of original land titles, deeds, and foundational records of sovereign ownership

verdicts.note: Deeds are kept by county recorders, and the 1814 fire destroyed federal buildings and the Library of Congress, not the nation's land titles.
